unbold: The content focuses on equipping trainee music teachers with effective pedagogical content knowledge and teaching methods to deliver inclusive, context-responsive Musical Arts. Through structured activities such as ensemble work, composition tasks, and community-based music projects, trainees engage in practical experiences that promote critical thinking, active participation, and responsible citizenship.

Cross-cutting themes and emerging issues - including National Values and Principles, Life Skills and Health Education, Climate Change Education, Financial Education, Digital Literacy, and Social and Emotional Learning are integrated into music pedagogy. This equips trainee teachers with diverse teaching strategies to design and deliver engaging music lessons that empower learners to acquire essential life skills, adapt to their environment, make informed decisions, and contribute meaningfully to national development.

Ultimately, the goal is for trainee teachers to master innovative and learner-centered music teaching methods that inspire and nurture responsible, active citizens through the transformative power of music education.
Demonstrate knowledge, practical skills, values, and positive attitudes in Musical Arts.
Plan, prepare, and effectively deliver competence-based Musical Arts lessons.
Design and develop appropriate teaching and learning materials for Musical Arts.
Apply entrepreneurial knowledge and skills in music-related activities and ventures.
Demonstrate performance, creativity, coordination, observation, and self-expression through vocal, instrumental, and other musical activities.
